name: tinynoise
title: Tinynoise
description: Play local background sounds from ~/Music/Tinynoise. Playback runs in a small shell loop, with no JavaScript engine kept alive.
author: mimukit

commands.name: play-sound
commands.title: Play Sound
commands.subtitle: Tinynoise
commands.description: Pick a background sound from ~/Music/Tinynoise and play it on a loop.

commands.name: stop-sound
commands.title: Stop Sound
commands.subtitle: Tinynoise
commands.description: Stop the background sound that plays now.

commands.name: toggle-sound
commands.title: Toggle Sound
commands.subtitle: Tinynoise
commands.description: Stop the background sound, or play the last sound again.
